issues.legal_issue: The amended requirement to notify a tenant of each rent default applies to an ejectment proceeding where the tenancy was terminated and the proceeding was brought after the amendment took effect.
material_facts: The tenant had defaulted in rent for three years before the amendment took effect.
The landlord issued the notice terminating the tenancy after the amendment took effect.
The landlord applied for possession after the amendment took effect.
The landlord had not notified the tenant of each default within six months, as the amended proviso required.
issues.conclusion: The amended proviso applied. The landlord had no accrued right to proceed without complying with its notice requirement, and the appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Section 28(1) of the Hyderabad Tenancy and Agricultural Lands Act, 1950, as amended by Section 7 of the 1960 Amendment Act, excluded the statutory relief where the tenant had failed to pay rent for three years and the landlord had not intimated each default within six months. A mere right to take advantage of a statutory provision is not an accrued right. The Court relied on Abbot v. Minister of Land (1895) AC 425, followed in Sakharam v. Manikchand Mothichand Shah, Hungerford Investment Trust Limited v. Haridas Mundhra, and Lalji Raja & Sons v. Hansraj Nathuram. Because both the termination notice and the possession application followed the amendment, the asserted right to institute the proceeding had not accrued before the change.

predicates.ejectment_for_rent_default: The proceeding sought to eject a tenant for nonpayment of rent.
predicates.termination_after_notice_requirement: The landlord terminated the tenancy after a legal change began requiring timely notice of each rent default.
predicates.possession_application_after_notice_requ: The landlord applied for possession after that legal change began requiring timely notice of each rent default.

issues.definition: When an ejectment proceeding for rent nonpayment follows a termination and application made after the timely-notice requirement took effect, that requirement applies.
